name: Camtasia
tagline: Camtasia's solo core is compact: build a local screen recording + editing workflow that imports user-owned media, applies the core edit or transformation, previews it, and exports a standard file. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on media pipeline, hosting, distribution.
